caseNameFull: Kalodner, Judge v. Webster Eisenlohr, Inc.
attorneys: Mr. Hirsh W. Stalberg for petitioner. Mr. Paul D. Miller for respondent. Assistant Solicitor General Cox, Messrs. Roger S. Foster, Milton V. Freeman, Theodore L. Thau and David Ferber filed a memorandum on behalf of the Securities & Exchange Commission, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
